items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Mark Warner was the leader on the Hit Parade over the years, and he was the conductor when Frank was around... He was always fighting with Frank Sinatra and ... I don't know, I can't even say the words I want to say.

ctx.x: Mark Warner was the leader on the Hit Parade over the years, and he was the conductor when Frank was around, becoming a bigger name as a single.
For some particular reason, they took different names.
